chapter: Friends, New York life and recording routine
title: Room rent and cooking a duck
summary: She paid five or six dollars a week for a sleeping room and tells of ruining a duck by buttering it.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Do you remember how much money you paid for your room?
Yeah, I was paying from five to six dollars.
A week?
Yeah.
Five, six dollars a week.
Uh-huh.
And that was with a little stove you had in the room?
in the kitchen .
Oh, you didn't have your own stove?
Oh, no. Uh-huh.
You just had a sleeping room.
Uh-huh. I just had a sleeping room.
And where was the stove?
I remember one time -- huh?
Where was the stove?
In the kitchen, their kitchen. I would cook .
Uh-huh.

I remember one time, I had never cooked a duck and I was going to have a duck and I didn't know how to cook . I was so young. I didn't know how to cook no duck, so I had the duck and put it all full of butter. You don't butter no duck.
(Laughter.)
And the butter was all over the stove (unintelligible). She just bawled me out . She knew
I was young, didn't know better. And I said, "Oh, excuse me. I didn't know." She said, "Honey, you don't put no butter on no duck."
(Laughter.)

She said, "Honey, you don't put no butter on no duck," said, "duck its own grease." Said, "You duck." I didn't know that. But if you don't know, you don't know. Mama was dead. Mama didn't cook no -- mama cooked duck all right, but I didn't know what she put in it.
(Laughter.)
I was trying to cook like mama, you know. Lord have mercy.
What else did you cook besides duck?
Well, I would cook some of everything, but I remember one . I cooked greens. I cooked stew, beef and I cooked a roast and I cooked cornbread and (inaudible) greens most everyday.
You cooked greens everyday?
Yeah, I cooked some kind of greens everyday, cabbage or (unintelligible) don't put no grease in and just have (unintelligible) steak and put (unintelligible).
(Laughter.)
Mama was dead. I did the best I could.
